remarks: Location, location, location! Welcome to 150 Hope St Unit 14. Complex is close to Glenbrook Train Station and Downtown. Walkable distance to Julia Stark Elementary School and Stamford High School. Best unit in the complex with 3 bedrooms, 1 1/2 bathrooms, freshly painted and carpeted. Private location, end unit with deeded two car attached garage and one assigned outside parking space. First floor has an open floor plan, perfect for entertaining. First floor offers the kitchen, dining room and living room, with a beautiful fireplace and sliders leading to a private patio. First floor also has the laundry room, half bathroom and door leading to the attached garages. Upstairs you will find the bedrooms and full bathroom.
